meta_title: Gillshill Gas & Plumbing | Gas Engineer Hull
meta_description: Gillshill Gas & Plumbing in Hull. Gas Safe registered heating engineer, boiler repairs, installations and servicing. Emergency call-outs available.
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdown at 2am in Hull? We're out within the hour, any day of the week.
services_subhead: From routine boiler servicing to emergency repairs and full system installations, we cover every aspect of residential gas heating.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Diagnostics
services.desc: No heat, strange noises, or pilot light issues? We diagnose faults fast and carry common parts on the van. Most repairs completed same day.

services.title: Annual Boiler Servicing
services.desc: Keep your boiler running safely and efficiently. Annual checks protect your warranty and catch problems before they become expensive.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: New condensing boiler fitted with full system commissioning. We handle all pipework, controls, and paperwork — you get a 10-year guarantee.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Bleeding
services.desc: Cold patches on radiators, leaks, or valves stuck? We'll fix the problem and balance your heating so every room warms evenly.

services.title: Central Heating Upgrades
services.desc: Old system inefficient? We'll design a new heating layout tailored to your home, install it to Building Regulations, and improve your energy bills.

services.title: Emergency Gas Callouts
services.desc: Smell gas? Boiler failed in winter? We respond 24/7 to urgent gas and heating emergencies across Hull and surrounding areas.

about_pullquote: I started this to do the job right, not just chase the quick call.
about_para_1: Gillshill Gas & Plumbing has been serving Hull homes for nearly two decades. We're Gas Safe registered and specialise in residential heating systems — boiler repairs, servicing, and installations. Every job is done to Building Regulations, and we stand behind our work with industry-standard guarantees.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we arrive on time, diagnose problems honestly, and never push unnecessary work. We're local to Hull, we know the area's housing stock, and we treat every home with the care we'd give our own. Whether it's a Sunday evening emergency or a planned installation, you get the same straightforward service.

reviews.text: Boiler packed in just before Christmas. Called Gillshill on a Sunday afternoon and they were round within an hour. Replaced the thermostat, sorted the whole thing, and left me with a hot house before dark. Couldn't ask for better service, fair price too.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had a new boiler installed. The engineer explained everything clearly, tidied up after himself, and the installation was meticulous. Been running perfectly for 8 months now. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Simon H.

reviews.text: Annual service done. Quick, professional, and he spotted a small problem with the pump before it became big. That's why we call them back every year — they know what they're doing.
reviews.author: David R.
